summary: Full backend/frontend health check completed against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All requested FastAPI endpoint/auth/content behaviors passed; the regression suite was 24/25 with only the previously documented ingress CORS override failing (excluded as a known infrastructure issue). Frontend landing, welcome/cookie persistence, theme, News/Wissen/Unternehmen navigation, login/register forms, news content, and local assets load. End-to-end is not healthy: requested bank dropdown entries and stock/BBVA routes are absent, the exact Supabase signup is rejected, and public pages produce extensive Supabase/React console errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Dropdown contains product/category links only; requested BBVA, ING, Postbank, bunq, and Knab options are all absent.

integration_issues.issue: Both /aktien and /stocks are undefined and wildcard-redirect to /. No stock overview is reachable through either requested route.
Both /banken/bbva and /bbva are undefined and wildcard-redirect to /. Existing /banks/bbva/* routes are access-code protected and do not satisfy either requested alias.
/formular renders only the secure access-code gate, not an account-opening wizard; /kontoeroeffnung is undefined and redirects home. Wizard flow could not be entered without a formular access code.

UI signup using required testuser+e2e@example.com / TestPass123! fails. Supabase POST /auth/v1/signup returns 400 code=email_address_invalid; UI shows the raw English provider message. No user is created, so authenticated /dashboard or /me context cannot be verified; login correctly reports invalid credentials.

Five-route Home/News/Comparison/Login/About/Impressum sequence produced 115 console errors (zero uncaught pageerror events). Home/Login showcase issues live Supabase queries as fake user showcase-user, causing repeated 400s; stock-history and public News stock-prices edge calls return 401; React also logs fetchPriority and invalid SVG path errors.

No local /assets/marketing, /assets/bank-logos, or hero asset failed, but external hot-linked BBVA, BNP, ING, DKB, Spuerkeess, Millennium BCP, and CaixaBank logo requests are blocked/failed (ORB, NotSameOrigin, HTTP2), adding console noise and forcing fallbacks.

action_items: Add the required bank entries to the Angebote menu or align the accepted navigation contract.
Add explicit /aktien or /stocks and /banken/bbva or /bbva routes instead of silently redirecting unknown routes to home.
Expose the intended account-opening wizard route or provide test access for the /formular gate.
Use/configure a Supabase-accepted QA mailbox domain and localize email_address_invalid; retest signup, approval/confirmation, login, and user context.
Prevent showcase components from mounting live NotificationCenter/stock-history calls, and make public News market calls use a public endpoint or valid authorization.
Self-host partner bank logos under /assets to avoid hot-link blocking.
Retest frontend routes, console, and Supabase auth after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardTopbar receives showcase=true but still renders NotificationCenter; the fake showcase AuthContext user therefore triggers eight live Supabase table queries on public Home/Login. Suppress live widgets in showcase mode.
MarktuebersichtSidebar mounts on public /news and calls the stock-prices Edge Function six times without an authenticated session, producing 401s even though the news feed itself renders.
App.js is 792 lines and exceeds the 700-line maintainability limit; split public, dashboard, admin, and bank route declarations into focused modules.
AuthContext remains entirely Supabase-based while apiClient/FastAPI auth is unused, so backend auth passing does not constitute frontend-backend auth integration.
Unknown requested routes are masked by the catch-all Navigate to=/; add explicit aliases or a real not-found page so missing features are observable.
Many interactive controls still lack data-testid, including desktop nav group buttons, theme/search buttons, news controls, and /formular fields.
BankingHero passes fetchPriority to a motion.img and logs a React DOM warning; the rendered chart stack also supplies undefined SVG path data on initial public render.

success_rate.backend: 100% of requested endpoints/behaviors; 96% regression suite (24/25, sole failure is known ingress CORS infrastructure)

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created unique TEST_ Mongo users/login-attempt/reset-token data and cleaned it in teardown. Supabase rejected the requested signup before user creation, so no Supabase seed user was created.
test_credentials: Backend admin credentials were read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and passed login/hash/cookie tests. /app/auth_testing.md is missing. Frontend Supabase test user could not be created because Supabase rejected the required example.com address.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse the existing pytest suite. Frontend visitor state keys are kapitalmitte_visitor_profile and kapitalmitte_cookie_consent. Verified passes: welcome Accept stores both, theme persists dark, no Supabase-not-configured toast, News/Wissen/Unternehmen click navigation, login/register controls, populated News feed, and zero broken local /assets images. Retest missing aliases, Angebote bank options, exact/updated signup mailbox, dashboard context, and console cleanliness.
rca_of_the_issue: Route failures are deterministic: App.js declares none of /kontoeroeffnung, /aktien, /stocks, /banken/bbva, or /bbva, then catch-all redirects to /. Angebote is sourced from siteCopy.nav.groups and contains product links rather than bank links. Signup reaches the configured original Supabase project but Auth rejects the reserved example.com address with email_address_invalid. Public console failures come from mock showcase composition leaking live behavior (DashboardTopbar always mounts NotificationCenter for showcase-user), unauthenticated Edge Function calls from stock-history/stock-prices, and externally hot-linked logo providers blocking cross-origin image delivery.
